records.title: LUT Scholarship and Early Bird Discount (master's studies)

source.raw_extract: Page fetched in full; it states no application deadline, no application window and does not use the words rolling or 'no fixed deadline' for either award. Verbatim: "First academic year: Early bird discount - If you are required to pay tuition fees, you will receive an Early bird discount of EUR 5,000. To qualify, you must: accept your study place and pay the remaining first-year tuition fee of EUR 10,000 within 21 days of your official admission email." and "Second academic year: LUT scholarship - If you are required to pay tuition fees, you will receive a LUT scholarship of EUR 5,000. To qualify, you must: complete at least 60 ECTS credits during your first academic year in accordance with your personal study plan and pay the second-year tuition fee on time. The required 60 ECTS credits must be included on your Transcript of Records by 31 July (the end of the academic year). Progress is checked automatically."
source.notes: No calendar application deadline exists for this award pair. Both are granted automatically on admission ('you will receive'), and the only time conditions are relative rather than calendar: the early bird discount runs from the date of the admission email ('within 21 days of your official admission email') and the LUT scholarship is checked against an academic-year milestone ('by 31 July (the end of the academic year)'). '31 July' is a recurring end-of-year ECTS check, not an application deadline, and must not be written as a deadline_date. The shard's official_source_url (https://www.lut.fi/en/tuition-fees-and-scholarships) is dead (HTTP 404); the live equivalent is the page cited above.

rejected_sources.reason: States the master's ADMISSION window '1 October 2026 at 8:00 (UTC+3)-31 March 2027 at 23:59 (UTC+3)' and 'Applications are processed on a rolling basis'.
